rationale: The described portfolio performs application performance analysis, test-data optimization, and mainframe debugging/fault management; these are conventional profiling, testing and troubleshooting functions.
evidence_spans: Strobe is the industry-leading mainframe application performance management and analysis solution for mainframe applications. ... With Strobe, mainframe teams can: Locate and improve resource-consumptive database calls.
